action-button.name: action-button
action-button.description: A button that can ask for confirmation. A pending action can offer retry and cancel. The icon and display must match the binding. The icon display shows the label on hover and focus. After a successful receipt, the button shows Done and uses a check in an icon display.

action-queue.name: action-queue
action-queue.description: The actions of the offline queue of the application, each with its state as text and its exits. A waiting action shows as pending, never as done. The application fills it from its queue, not a model.

button.name: button
button.description: A button. It sends a press event to the code that contains it. It does not send an action.

card.name: card
card.description: A card with a title, optional details and an optional collapse control.

card-grid.name: card-grid
card-grid.description: A labeled list of cards with optional Expand all and Collapse all controls.

chart.name: chart
chart.description: An SVG chart with a table view. Categories and series must not be empty. Each series has one value per category. Stacks keep positive and negative totals separate. Arrow keys move through points in series order and wrap at each end. A new fill resets the point and closes the table.

chart-series.name: chart-series
chart-series.description: A named series in a chart. Values follow the category order. The chart checks that the value count equals the category count.

choice-cell.name: choice-cell
choice-cell.description: A cell of a data grid with one of the choices of its column. A cell with no value is empty.

choice-field.name: choice-field
choice-field.description: A labeled group of choices. A person selects one choice. The value must be one of the choices.

citation.name: citation
citation.description: The source of a claim: a source name, a locator as text, an optional quote and an open button.

data-grid.name: data-grid
data-grid.description: A grid with typed cells. The status gives the reason for a wait. If no receipt comes back, the grid offers Retry and Cancel. Cancel keeps the sent edit Changed if it is the last edit of the cell. A newer edit stays ready to send. A successful receipt shows Done. The kit computes no formula.

data-grid-column.name: data-grid-column
data-grid-column.description: One column of a data grid: a key, a header label, the type of its cells and an optional read-only flag. A choice column gives its choices.

data-grid-row.name: data-grid-row
data-grid-row.description: One row of a data grid: a key, a header label and one cell for each column.

date-cell.name: date-cell
date-cell.description: A cell of a data grid with a date value as YYYY-MM-DD. A cell with no value is empty.

date-field.name: date-field
date-field.description: A labeled date input as YYYY-MM-DD. A person edits the date. The input refuses a date that does not exist or that is outside the range.

diff.name: diff
diff.description: The difference between two versions of a text or a list of fields, in parts that a person can open and close.

diff-change.name: diff-change
diff-change.description: One change of a diff: a label, the kind of the change, and the value before and after.

diff-part.name: diff-part
diff-part.description: One part of a diff: a title and its changes. A person can open and close the part.

editable-form.name: editable-form
editable-form.description: A form with up to 20 fields of text, long text, numbers, ranges, dates, choices and yes or no values. A person edits the values and submits them as one action, with the type of each edit of a typed field. A pending action with no receipt offers a retry and a cancel.

excerpt.name: excerpt
excerpt.description: A passage of a source document as text, with a marked span, the source name and the locator of the passage.

fact.name: fact
fact.description: A label and a value in a card.

field.name: field
field.description: A labeled text input. A person edits the value. If the field is typed, the person also gives the type of each edit.

form-card.name: form-card
form-card.description: A long form in sections that shows each field as a label and a value. A person edits one field in place and sends the changes as one action. A pending action with no receipt offers a retry and a cancel.

form-line.name: form-line
form-line.description: One line of a form card: an optional line number, a field and a read-only flag.

form-section.name: form-section
form-section.description: A titled section of a form card with up to 40 lines.

grid.name: grid
grid.description: A labeled group that puts its child elements in columns of equal width.

image.name: image
image.description: An image in a fixed box with an optional caption. Page code permits origins. Only http and https URLs can load. A text alternative is required unless decorative is true. Loading and error keep the box. Error shows the alternative. A native dialog gives the full-size view and returns focus on close.

long-text-field.name: long-text-field
long-text-field.description: A labeled input for long text in more than one line. A person edits the text.

number-cell.name: number-cell
number-cell.description: A cell of a data grid with a number value. A cell with no value is empty.

number-field.name: number-field
number-field.description: A labeled number input. A person edits the number. The input refuses a value that is not a number or that is outside the range.

queued-action.name: queued-action
queued-action.description: One action in the offline queue, with its state as text. The state is queued, sent, stalled or rejected. No state is done.

range-field.name: range-field
range-field.description: One or two named sliders each have a named number box. A native label names the first slider. A pair has a named group. Values use steps from the minimum and stay in range and in order. An invalid edit keeps the last value and shows the reason, with the limits for a number outside the range.

rich-code.name: rich-code
rich-code.description: A code block node of rich text. The kit shows the text as text in a fixed-width font and runs nothing.

rich-heading.name: rich-heading
rich-heading.description: A heading node of rich text. The level is relative to the first heading level that page code sets. A heading cannot skip a level.

rich-link.name: rich-link
rich-link.description: An inline link node of rich text. The kit shows a button with the link text, and shows the target on hover and on focus. Page code sets the schemes that can open. The target opens only after a person presses the button.

rich-list.name: rich-list
rich-list.description: A list node of rich text, with bullets or with numbers. Each item is a paragraph node.

rich-paragraph.name: rich-paragraph
rich-paragraph.description: A paragraph node of rich text: a list of inline nodes. It is also the content of a list item and of a quote.

rich-quote.name: rich-quote
rich-quote.description: A quote node of rich text: a list of paragraph nodes.

rich-span.name: rich-span
rich-span.description: An inline text node of rich text, with one optional mark: emphasis, strong or code.

rich-text.name: rich-text
rich-text.description: Rich text as a tree of typed nodes: paragraphs, headings, lists, code blocks and quotes. A fill gives data only, never markup. The kit makes each element from a fixed list. Page code sets the link schemes and the first heading level.

select-field.name: select-field
select-field.description: A labeled combobox for one choice. Each choice is unique, and a given value must be one of the choices. A list of more than seven choices has a search box. The search matches text in any part of a choice and ignores case. The field announces when there is no match.

source-status.name: source-status
source-status.description: The state of an offline data source of the application as text: ready, stale, empty or error.

stack.name: stack
stack.description: A labeled group that puts its child elements in one column or one row.

status.name: status
status.description: One state with short text. The application or service gives the state. Pending has a dashed border, Passed a solid border, Failed a double border and Unknown a dotted border. Each state shows its label as text.

table.name: table
table.description: Text columns and rows with optional status text. Columns must not be empty. Each row has one cell per column. Each status is in status_values. The sort key is a zero-based column index. Sort direction needs a sort key. Equal cells keep their input order. A new fill resets the sort.

table-row.name: table-row
table-row.description: A row in a table. Cells follow the column order. The optional status is text from the application or the service. The table checks the cell count and the allowed status values.

text.name: text
text.description: A run of text. The kit always shows the value as text, never as markup.

text-cell.name: text-cell
text-cell.description: A cell of a data grid with a text value. A cell with no value is empty.

toggle-field.name: toggle-field
toggle-field.description: A labeled yes or no field. The switch display adds role="switch" to the same native checkbox and shows On or Off. The value is false if the fill does not give it.

upload.name: upload
upload.description: A person picks or drops files. Page code binds the tool and the limits. The control checks each file before the application sends it. A file with no receipt offers Retry and Cancel after the wait limit. Done shows only after a successful receipt. The receipt can show a reference with a copy control.
